summary: Verified password-manager autofill semantic markup fix across PulseLandingPage, CRMLogin, MODServiceLogin, StaffLogin. Pulse login dialog markup is correct on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): <form autocomplete='on'>, username input (name='username', id='login-username', autocomplete='username'), password input (type='password', name='password', id='login-password', autocomplete='current-password'). Login still works end-to-end — POST /api/auth/login returned 200 with JWT token; dialog closed; no 'Sign-in failed' toast. CRMLogin and MODServiceLogin pages were not reachable at /crm or /mod* on this preview host (/crm redirects to /login?next=/crm because CRM/MOD portals are gated behind host-based detection isModServiceMode()/CRM app context), but source-code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/CRM/CRMLogin.js (lines 171, 176) and /app/frontend/src/pages/MODPortal/MODServiceLogin.js (lines 434-437, 462-465) confirms the required name/id/autocomplete attributes are present. StaffLogin.js (lines 65, 71) also has correct name='username|password' + autoComplete='username|current-password' + id attributes.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMLogin and MODServiceLogin pages are not reachable at common public URLs on this preview — only via host/subdomain-based routing (isModServiceMode()/CRM app shell). This limits browser-level verification; code-level review was used to confirm fix. Not a bug for this task.
/login route appears to render a Pulse login card (not StaffLogin). StaffLogin.js markup is correct but worth confirming whether /login still uses StaffLogin or a different component (not in scope).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 forms verified: Pulse desktop, Pulse mobile, CRM via source, MOD via source; login end-to-end passed)
